plan.title: Gentler first drops
plan.question: Do new players with slower first drops (0.45 instead of 0.6) finish the first day and come back more? Only brand-new players are affected, so it runs 4 weeks to collect enough installs.
plan.decide: Adopt 0.45 if more players finish the first day and day-1 retention isn't lower. If it's the same, keep 0.6 (faster feels better).
